text:
anya: Kicking off v2 staged rollout to prod-us in ~5m. Target: 10% -> 25% over 20m if stable. Will monitor p95 and auth/quota errors.

deploybot: Canary plan: rollout-id r-214, start at 6167891250, initial 10% traffic. Thresholds set: errors > 1.2% OR p95 > 1.8x baseline -> pause.

cal: Quick FYI - middleware changes in v2 alter streaming frame counting. There's a risk of double-counting token frames at the edge. Haven't seen it in staging.

ravi: I can preemptively pin high-throughput tenants if needed. Who's on reserved plans?

cal: Top: tenant-7f, tenant-44, tenant-salesforce. Watch those first.

ops-qa: Canary started at 6167891250. Initial telemetry clean. Watching per-tenant now.

deploybot: Update: canary progressed to 25% at 6167891265.

ops-qa: Alert: tenant-44 saw a burst of 429s at ~6167891272. Localized but above threshold.

anya: Pause rollout. deploybot, pin tenant-44 and tenant-7f to v1. Throttle streaming retries at the edge.

deploybot: Executing:
```
/deploy pause r-214
/deploy pin tenant-44 v1
/deploy pin tenant-7f v1
```
Pins applied; canary paused at 6167891278.

cal: Root cause: streaming handler increments meter twice when CONTINUE follows DATA quickly. PR #912 fixes the guard.

ravi: Can we hotpatch edge-proxy canaries only? If CI green, push edge-only image and validate.

cal: Built `edge-v2.0.2-hotfix-1`. CI passed unit + integration.

ops-qa: After pinback, tenant-44 429s stopped. Global error rate back to baseline.

anya: Plan: deploy hotfix to canary edge nodes, validate 10m. If stable, resume staged rollout with extra holds: 10% -> 15% -> 25% with 10m waits. Add a note to release notes.

release-notes-bot: Draft: "v2 initial rollout: streaming frame double-counting could trigger reserved quota 429s for a subset of tenants. Hotfix edge-v2.0.2-hotfix-1 deployed; affected tenants pinned to v1 during mitigation."

ops-qa: Will open an incident if more tenants appear. For now closing thread after hotfix validation.

cal: Backporting fix and adding integration test for framing edge-case.

anya: Thanks all. Re-open when hotfix validated and we re-run the staged rollout.
